ip_top_stories.title: Sony Copyright Suit Survives AI Music Generator's Dismissal Bid
ip_top_stories.summary: A court has declined to dismiss Sony's copyright lawsuit against an AI music generator, allowing the case to proceed. The ruling is a significant development in ongoing litigation over AI-generated content and music copyright.

ip_top_stories.title: Copyright owners v AI developers: the emerging trends
ip_top_stories.summary: An analysis of the evolving legal landscape between copyright holders and AI developers, examining emerging litigation trends and key legal questions being tested in courts. The piece surveys how rights owners are pushing back against AI training on protected works.

ip_top_stories.title: Is the government's stance on AI copyright holding back the UK tech scene?
ip_top_stories.summary: The article examines the UK government's position on AI and copyright, questioning whether its approach is hampering the domestic technology sector. It comes amid ongoing debate over proposed text and data mining exceptions and the rights of creators.

ip_top_stories.title: Anthropic Code Crisis Creates Copyright Contradiction
ip_top_stories.summary: Anthropic faces a copyright contradiction arising from its AI coding tools, with questions raised about ownership and infringement when AI systems generate code. The story highlights the unresolved legal tensions around AI-produced software.

ip_top_stories.title: Bologna Children's Book Fair 2026: AI Takes Center Stage
ip_top_stories.summary: At the 2026 Bologna Children's Book Fair, artificial intelligence emerged as a dominant topic, with publishers and creators debating its impact on children's publishing. The Publishers Weekly report covers industry sentiment and key discussions around AI-generated content.

ip_further_links.title: Can AI Legally Clone Open Source? Unpacking 'Clean Room As A Service' - Copyright - United Kingdom
ip_further_links.summary: An analysis of whether AI systems can legally replicate open source code under a 'clean room' approach, examining the copyright implications under UK law.

ip_further_links.title: Delhi HC Directs Time-Bound Decision on AI Generated Artwork Copyright Plea
ip_further_links.summary: The Delhi High Court has directed authorities to reach a time-bound decision on a petition concerning copyright protection for AI-generated artwork.

ip_further_links.title: MPA Chief On 'Going To The Mat' With Instagram, Copyright, AI & Pushing A Federal Film Tax Incentive
ip_further_links.summary: The Motion Picture Association's chief discusses the organisation's aggressive stance on copyright enforcement against AI platforms and social media, alongside advocacy for a federal film tax incentive.

ip_further_links.title: AI in the patent industry: Don't believe the hype. Believe the data.
ip_further_links.summary: IPKat examines data-driven claims about AI's actual impact on patent prosecution and the patent industry, urging caution about inflated expectations.

ip_further_links.title: Mexico's New AI Law Could Hinder USMCA Review, Warns AMITI
ip_further_links.summary: Mexico's technology industry association AMITI has warned that the country's new AI legislation could complicate the upcoming USMCA trade agreement review.

ip_further_links.title: Is the internet's memory at risk? The world's most-used archiving tool is under threat
ip_further_links.summary: A report on threats facing the Internet Archive, a key tool for preserving digital content, with implications for access to information and copyright-related disputes.

ip_further_links.title: Bloomsbury Reorganizes Its Global Publishing Business
ip_further_links.summary: Bloomsbury has announced a reorganisation of its global publishing operations, a development of note for the publishing industry amid ongoing pressures from AI and digital transformation.

ip_further_links.title: Guest Post — From Open Access to Preprints: Are We Repeating the Same Mistakes in Scholarly Publishing?
ip_further_links.summary: The Scholarly Kitchen publishes a guest analysis questioning whether the scholarly publishing community is making the same structural errors with preprints as it did during the transition to open access.

ip_further_links.title: GitHub Policy Update
ip_further_links.summary: GitHub has issued a policy update with potential implications for AI-generated code, open source licensing, and developer IP rights.

ip_further_links.title: Fordham 33 (Report 5): Trade secrets
ip_further_links.summary: IPKat reports from the Fordham IP Conference on key discussions around trade secrets law and its intersection with emerging technologies.
